audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer is built around an ability called "Dash Chain". Ambessa has no such ability. The name appears in winCon, enemyWin, tradeBad, breakdown.wave, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, loading, focus, two dosFull entries, one dontsFull entry and four report rows.
audit.why: Her real abilities are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E) and Public Execution (R). "Dash Chain" is a fabrication, and focus.letters pointed it at E, which is Lacerate.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the correct ability in every writable path I could reach inside the fixed-length band, and repointed focus to Repudiation (W).

audit.whatIsWrong: Repudiation's damage amplification was never mentioned, so the text encourages exactly the wrong play.
audit.why: Riot's text: "If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage." Poking a bracing Ambessa with Radiant Volley makes her slam hit harder. The old text told Mel to keep fanning volleys.
audit.corrected: Made this the tldr, and threaded it through tradeGood, tradeBad, phases[3].why, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].t and the Key Ability Interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Public Execution's targeting rule is absent, and it is the single most important positioning fact in the matchup after laning.
audit.why: Riot's text: she "blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing." Standing at the back of a teamfight formation makes Mel the target, not the safe one — the opposite of normal backline instinct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Drakehound's Step is never named or explained, yet it is what actually closes the gap.
audit.why: Riot's text: an attack or movement command entered while casting an ability makes her dash once the ability resolves, and it refunds energy. Her dash is not a cooldown you can wait out — it rides every cast.
audit.corrected: Added to phases[2].why, dosFull[0] and content whys[2] and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content breakdown told the player to "Hold W to eat her engage if it has a projectile component" — a hedge, and the answer is no.
audit.why: None of Ambessa's five abilities carry a projectile flag. Rebuttal's reflect half does nothing in this matchup; only its damage prevention and move speed matter.
audit.corrected: Stated plainly in phases[1].why and loading. The hedged mid-breakdown sentence itself is outside the paths I edited; flagged here.

audit.whatIsWrong: "your only defensive layer is gone for twenty seconds" understates Rebuttal by roughly half, and the cooldown section gave no number for anything of hers.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26. Public Execution is 130/115/100 and Repudiation is 18/17/16/15/14. The 130-second ultimate downtime at rank 1 is the widest window in the matchup and it was never quantified.
audit.corrected: Real numbers added to tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns, phases[4].why, dosFull[2].d and the All-In Windows row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The range gap is never stated, and it is why the early levels are Mel's.
audit.why: Cunning Sweep is 650, Repudiation and Lacerate are both 325. Radiant Volley is 950 and Solar Snare 1000. Only Public Execution, at 1250, outranges her.
audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.early, phases[0].why, phases[4].why and content whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0] paired the title "Snare the landing spot of Dash Chain" with a description about the same non-existent ability, and dontsFull[2] carried the unrelated Rebuttal boilerplate.
audit.why: Template bleed, compounded by the fabricated name.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around Drakehound's Step and the Repudiation brace.

audit.why: Public Execution carries a heal component, so Grievous Wounds timing matters in extended fights.
audit.corrected: No edit — the Itemization row is silent on anti-heal for this matchup, which is a real gap, but I could not fit the addition inside the fixed-length band without dropping a correct build line.

notes:
HIGHEST-PRIORITY FINDING: the full layer for this matchup is written around an ability called "Dash Chain", which Ambessa does not have. This is the same class of error as the Brand "Ares of Blaze" case in the calibration list. It appears in roughly fifteen strings including focus.text, and focus.letters pointed it at E (Lacerate). I replaced it wherever the fixed-length band allowed; a few occurrences sit in paths I did not edit — notably breakdown.feeding and the Trading Rules, Wave Management and Key Ability Interactions report rows still contain it in fragments I could not rewrite within +/-10%. ROOT CAUSE FOUND: champ-data/_gen-engine.js line 117 reads  ambessa: { slot:'E', name:'Dash Chain', cd:'12s', note:'Her passive dash weaving — fight when the chain is spent.', winT:'DASHES DOWN' }.  The name is invented, the slot is wrong (E is Lacerate, while the note describes the passive Drakehound's Step), and 12s matches no ability she has. Every champion file that generated an Ambessa matchup inherited it — the literal string "Dash Chain" appears in 30 champ-data files. Fixing that one table row and regenerating is worth far more than my per-string patches here. I did not touch _gen-engine.js.

Sample size: MC_REAL_GAMES.mel.ambessa is 6 games. 50% is 3 wins in 6.

Kit-flag false positives I deliberately did NOT write from: Ambessa's Repudiation and Public Execution both carry a derived "grounding" flag, which comes from the words "slams the ground" and "slams the enemy into the ground" in Riot's text. Neither ability grounds. Nothing in these proposals asserts grounding.

suspectNames false positive: "Solar Snare's" in spikes[0].text is correct with a possessive.
